sop_modules.name: Door Slab Stain/Clear Setup
sop_modules.description: Floor protection and wall masking for door slab stain and clear coat work.

tasks.name: Floor Protection Setup
tasks.description: Set up drop cloths under door work area. Stain drips are especially difficult to clean.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage under door swing area. Canvas drops preferred for stain work.

tasks.name: Wall Masking Adjacent to Door
tasks.description: Apply masking at wall adjacent to door opening. Required for spray. Also required when walls are SS_PAINTED_*.

quality_notes.all: Complete tape line at wall-door junction.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Floor protection first, then wall masking (if applicable).

sop_modules.name: Bare Wood Door Slab Preparation
sop_modules.description: Prepare bare wood door slab for staining. Sand to profile (120 then 150 grit), fill defects, grain raise treatment, tack clean.

tasks.name: Inspect Bare Wood Door
tasks.description: Visual inspection of bare wood door surfaces. Check for mill marks, dents, defects, grain consistency.

quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection — mark all visible defects
quality_notes.QT5: Thorough inspection under raking light — every imperfection

tasks.name: Sand Bare Wood (120 Grit)
tasks.description: Initial sanding with 120-grit to remove mill marks. Sand WITH grain direction.

quality_notes.all: Sand with grain only. Remove all mill marks. Pay attention to panel detail areas.

tasks.name: Sand Bare Wood (150 Grit)
tasks.description: Final prep sanding with 150-grit for smooth stain-ready surface.

quality_notes.all: Uniform scratch pattern. Surface smooth to touch.

tasks.name: Fill Defects (Stainable Wood Filler)
tasks.description: Fill nail holes, dents, and defects with stainable wood filler.

quality_notes.QT3: Fill open nail holes and obvious dents
quality_notes.QT5: Fill every defect. Color-match filler to expected stain color.

tasks.name: Grain Raise Treatment (Waterborne)
tasks.description: Wet-wipe bare wood to raise grain, let dry, re-sand with 220 grit.

quality_notes.all: Wet wipe entire surface. Let dry 1-2 hrs. Re-sand with 220 grit.

tasks.name: Tack Clean (Prep Complete)
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust from door surfaces with tack cloth.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed. Dust in stain creates visible defects.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect > Sand 120 > Sand 150 > Fill > Grain Raise (conditional) > Tack Clean.

sop_modules.name: Wood Conditioner Application
sop_modules.description: Apply pre-stain wood conditioner to softwood door slabs.

tasks.name: Apply Wood Conditioner
tasks.description: Brush on pre-stain wood conditioner liberally. Let penetrate ~15 min.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage including panel detail. Let dwell 15 minutes.

tasks.name: Wipe Excess Conditioner
tasks.description: Wipe off excess conditioner. Stain must be applied within 2 hours.

quality_notes.all: Wipe all excess. Surface slightly tacky, not wet.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Apply conditioner > Wait 15 min > Wipe excess > Apply stain within 2 hours.

sop_modules.name: Stain Application (Coat 1)
sop_modules.description: Apply first stain coat with wipe step.

tasks.name: Stain Coat 1 — Brush + Wipe
tasks.description: Apply stain with brush, working with grain. Maintain wet edge. Wipe excess with lint-free cloth.

quality_notes.all: Stain edges first, then faces. Wipe panel detail thoroughly to prevent pooling.

tasks.name: Stain Coat 1 — Spray + Wipe
tasks.description: Spray stain onto door surfaces. Wipe excess after dwell time.

quality_notes.all: Spray even coat. Back-brush into panel detail. Wipe evenly.

sop_modules.name: Stain Application (Coat 2)
sop_modules.description: Apply second stain coat for deeper color. Conditional: stain_coats = 2.

tasks.name: Stain Coat 2 — Apply + Wipe
tasks.description: Apply second stain coat using same method as coat 1. Wipe for color depth control.

quality_notes.all: Same method as coat 1. Verify color uniformity.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Second coat for deeper, more uniform color.

sop_modules.name: Stain Dry Verification
sop_modules.description: Verify stain is fully dry before sealer or clear coat.

tasks.name: Verify Stain Dry
tasks.description: Touch-test stain dryness. Oil: 4-8 hrs. Waterborne: 2 hrs.

quality_notes.all: Touch test in inconspicuous area. No tackiness. No color transfer.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Wait for full dry time, then verify.

sop_modules.name: Sanding Sealer Application (Coat 1)
sop_modules.description: Apply first coat of sanding sealer. Conditional: sealer_coats >= 1.

tasks.name: Apply Sanding Sealer (Coat 1)
tasks.description: Apply thin, even coat of sanding sealer.

quality_notes.all: Thin, even coat. Do not pool in panel detail.

sop_modules.name: Sealer Interstage + Coat 2
sop_modules.description: Sand first sealer coat and apply second. Conditional: sealer_coats = 2.

tasks.name: Sand Sealer (220 Grit)
tasks.description: Sand first sealer coat with 220-grit.

quality_notes.all: Sand entire surface. Do NOT sand through to stain.

tasks.name: Tack Clean Between Sealer Coats
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust before second sealer coat.

quality_notes.all: Complete dust removal.

tasks.name: Apply Sanding Sealer (Coat 2)
tasks.description: Apply second coat of sanding sealer.

quality_notes.all: Thin, even coat. Same technique as coat 1.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sand sealer > Tack > Apply sealer coat 2.

sop_modules.name: Final Sealer Sand Before Clear
sop_modules.description: Sand final sealer coat to smooth surface before clear topcoat. Conditional: sealer_coats >= 1.

tasks.name: Final Sealer Sand (320 Grit)
tasks.description: Final sand of sealer with 320-grit before clear topcoat.

quality_notes.all: Glass-smooth surface. Do NOT sand through to stain.

tasks.name: Tack Clean Before Clear Coat
tasks.description: Remove all sanding dust before first clear topcoat.

quality_notes.all: Meticulous dust removal. Every particle trapped in clear coat is visible.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sand 320 > Tack > Ready for clear coat 1.

tasks.name: Clear Coat 1 — Brush
tasks.description: Apply first clear topcoat with brush. Thin, even coat with grain. Tip once to level.

quality_notes.all: No drips, sags, holidays, or brush marks. Watch for runs at panel transitions.

tasks.name: Clear Coat 1 — Spray
tasks.description: Spray first clear topcoat. Consistent distance and speed.

quality_notes.all: No drips, sags, holidays, or orange peel.

sop_modules.name: Clear Coat Interstage
sop_modules.description: Sand between clear coats and inspect. Conditional: clear_coats >= 2.

tasks.name: Sand Clear Coat (320-400 Grit)
tasks.description: Sand cured clear coat with 320 grit (QT3-QT4) or 400 grit (QT5).

tasks.name: Tack Clean Between Clear Coats
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust before next clear coat.

quality_notes.all: Meticulous dust removal.

tasks.name: Inspect Clear Coat
tasks.description: Visual inspection of sanded clear coat before next coat.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sand clear > Tack > Inspect > Apply next clear coat.

sop_modules.name: Clear Topcoat Application (Coat 2)
sop_modules.description: Apply second clear topcoat. Conditional: clear_coats >= 2.

tasks.name: Clear Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second clear topcoat.

quality_notes.all: Same technique as coat 1. Faster — consistent substrate.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: After clear interstage. If clear_coats = 3, followed by another interstage + coat 3.

sop_modules.name: Clear Topcoat Application (Coat 3)
sop_modules.description: Apply third clear topcoat. Conditional: clear_coats = 3.

tasks.name: Clear Coat 3
tasks.description: Apply third and final clear topcoat. Maximum film build.

quality_notes.QT5: Final surface — zero tolerance for defects.

tasks.name: Protection Teardown
tasks.description: Remove floor drops and wall masking. Remove tape carefully near fresh clear coat.

quality_notes.all: Pull tape at 45 degrees away from fresh clear coat.

tasks.name: Final Inspection
tasks.description: Final quality check of all stained/clear-coated door surfaces.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick glance — uniform color, no obvious defects
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic scan — uniform color and sheen, no visible defects
quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection — zero tolerance, uniform across all surfaces

tasks.name: Touch-Up
tasks.description: Address defects found during final inspection. Spot sand and recoat as needed.

round_configurations.name: QT4 Stain + Sealer + Clear (4 Coats Total)
QT5 Stain + 2 Sealer + 3 Clear (6 Coats Total)

assumptions.value: All stain application methods include a wipe step — wipe time is built into the stain application rate
Sealer uses same application method as clear coat (application_method_clear drives both)
